sourcePolicy: Original generated PNG unchanged; RGBA TGA exported at 1024x1024 with LANCZOS resampling only if needed
basePrompt: Create one square 1024x1024 production fantasy campaign-map illustration for Azeroth Jewels, a jewel-matching WoW minigame. Use stylized-concept painterly isometric/high oblique game background art, rich atmospheric depth and polished terrain, readable at 512px. Full-bleed opaque background. One landscape only, no collage. Jewel crystals embedded in natural terrain, restrained faceted gems. A broad winding traversable route runs from lower left through middle to upper right, with ten naturally spaced quiet clearings suitable for native level buttons; do not paint buttons, circles, symbols, numbers, stars, text, lettering, banners, logos, borders, UI or characters. Keep upper 10% and lower 12% low-contrast for native title and navigation. Main route is calmer and less saturated than peripheral scenery. This is campaign art, not an actual match-three board. Cohesive premium hand-painted fantasy style throughout the set.
